name: com.cyberscorelab.www/cyberscore
title: CyberScore
description: Grade any domain's security A to F with plain-English fixes, and list exploited CVEs. Free.

tools.name: check_domain_security
tools.description: Run CyberScore’s free outside-in security check on a business domain (e.g. acme.com) and return its grade (A to F), score, the problems found with plain-English explanations and fix steps, and a link to the full report. Uses public information only: DNS and email records, the website’s certificate and headers, public certificate logs, and public internet-scan data. It also requests a few standard URLs on the website, as a browser could. Takes up to 30 seconds; results are cached for 10 minutes. Only check domains the user owns or is asked to assess.

domain.description: The domain to check, e.g. acme.com (no http:// needed)

tools.name: latest_exploited_vulnerabilities
tools.description: The newest vulnerabilities CISA has confirmed are being exploited in the wild (its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog), with vendor, product, date added and whether ransomware gangs use them. Updated daily.
